MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

2. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 10
   C. 81
   D. 9

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 30
   C. 23
   D. 46

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

8. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

9. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

11. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 19
   C. 88
   D. 38

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 105

16. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x = 5

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 22
   D. 77

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

19. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

21. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

22. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 7
   D. 6

23. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
